|gr1= Camera Control

|descr= focusRange is . Prepares the camera focus blur.

'''[-1,1]''' will reset default values (auto focusing), '''[-1,-1]''' will disable postprocessing (all is focused). Needs the call of [[camCommitPrepared]] to be conducted.

|s1= camera [[camPrepareFocus]] [distance, blur]

|p1= camera: [[Object]]

|p2= distance: [[Number]] - blur distance

|p3= blur: [[Number]] - blur intensity

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_camera camPrepareFocus [50, 1];</sqf>
